uncertainties: The warning 'swallowed by a Guardian' is interrupted in the source; the interruption is preserved. Chosen bearer terminology provisional.
text:
The key...
There's more than one...
Stop... it...
Only hope can
banish despair...!
Ah...!?
Ah...!?
By a Guardian...
Being swallowed...!?
Aaaaaaargh!!
Hey! Hey, wait!?
Wait!
Please!
...
Because you
were a chosen bearer.
That is why...
!?
!?
The source of my power is the spirit.
My ability is to give
strength of spirit
the form of a blade...
Strength of spirit...
Strength of spirit...
A strong spirit and strong feelings.
Those who lack either
are unworthy to wield me.
Wait!
That makes no sense... Kyle
and Azlier were aboard
that ship too.
Their spirits and feelings
should be far stronger
than mine...
Please, wait!
That makes no sense... Kyle
and Azlier were aboard
that ship too, weren't they?
Their spirits and feelings
should be far stronger
than mine...
But those alone
cannot bring about inheritance.
Huh?
Huh?
Only once a complete inheritance
has been achieved
will I attain my true form.
Wavelength, radiance, form.
One with the potential
to fulfill all three...
Thus, a chosen bearer.
A chosen bearer...
A chosen bearer...
Inherit...
Everything...
Ghh...!?
Ah...!?
Become one...
Uaaaagh!?
It will be...
too late...
●!?
!?
!?
Hah, hah...
Hah, hah...
Are you all right?
Yeah...
I'm all right now.
Oh, yes...
I'm all right now.
That green sword
you were holding just now...
Is that the Azure Sage
everyone's been talking about?
Come to think of it...
I still haven't properly
explained things to Ishlar...
